effects: Emits one ExitRequest(msg.sender, pubkey) event for each validator public key given. This is an off-chain signal asking the node operator (Kiln) to exit those validators.
No tokens or ETH move, no approval is set, and no on-chain state changes. The function is not payable and does not check that the signer owns the validators.
formats.shown: The screen says "Request Validator Exit" and lists the validator public keys as raw bytes.

couldNotCheck: No source in the working directory for the chain 560048 deployment (0x06f9C32A3093DDE837a2E172041DF79B4b850A2e). I assumed it is the same ExitRequestContract as on mainnet.
